$comment: Numeric screening/attempt/retry/spend ceilings for the PyJWT pilot and, where noted, later experiments. Each ceiling names whether it comes from real measured/priced evidence gathered this pass, or is a provisional policy default pending real data. None of these are the frozen M6/M7 benchmark-wide numbers -- those still require Phase 6 curation.

spend_ceilings.pyjwt_pilot_hard_spend_ceiling_basis: measured-evidence-derived: real evidence-packet size (pilot_estimate.json#measured_inputs) x real dated Haiku-4.5 pricing (pilot_config.json#price_schedule) projects a worst-case 2-replicate pilot cost of ~$0.05 (pilot_estimate.json#cost_projection_usd). $2.00 is a ~40x safety margin over that projection, chosen so an abort-on-ceiling policy triggers only on a genuine runaway (e.g. an infinite repair loop bypassing the proposal cap) rather than on ordinary variance in output length.
spend_ceilings.abort_policy: If cumulative billed cost for the PyJWT pilot would exceed this ceiling, stop issuing new requests immediately, keep all requests already made and billed in the record, and treat any in-flight budget point not reached as 'not attempted -- spend ceiling', not as a failure.
spend_ceilings.sqlalchemy_pydantic_pilot_spend_ceilings: NOT SET by this pass. Their pilots were not run and their evidence packets were not written, so no measured-evidence-derived projection exists for them yet -- see protocol.md#10.

screening_ceilings.basis: PROVISIONAL DEFAULT, NOT derived from measured evidence. Phase 6 curation has not started (per ROADMAP.md and protocol.md, by design -- curation follows M0). These numbers are placeholders carried from the roadmap's own planning ranges (3-5 admitted development repos per pilot migration, implying meaningfully more than 20 screened is unlikely to be needed at this stage) so the expansion-rule machinery in protocol.md#7 has a concrete number to compare real curation logs against. They MUST be revised the first time a real Phase 6 curation session records actual screened-repo counts and hours; until then, treat them as a guess explicitly labeled as a guess, not evidence.
screening_ceilings.revision_trigger: First real Phase 6 curation session for any pilot migration.

attempt_ceilings.generation_replicates_basis: Registered in pilot_config.json#generation_replicates_pyjwt_pilot as a policy decision (smallest count that can show any repeatable-vs-fluke signal at roughly 2x, not 10x, the single-replicate cost) made before any generation call -- not derived from an outcome.
attempt_ceilings.repair_proposal_sweep_basis: Restated from ROADMAP.md#development-set-repair-policy and protocol.md#5 -- a pre-existing design commitment, not newly derived.
attempt_ceilings.v1_repair_cap_rationale: FROZEN FOR M0. Capped at 3 proposals (1 initial proposal + up to 2 repair iterations) for Arm D evaluated on held-out repositories. Pre-registered prior to held-out evaluation based on literature precedent (BigBag, SPELL) showing >80% of fixable AST/rule syntax errors resolve in 1-2 feedback rounds, whereas proposals 4 and 5 exhibit severe diminishing returns and overfitting to test diagnostics. At cap=3, token spend is strictly bounded to preserve the economic frontier against direct-patching baselines (Arms A and B). Development-set exploration will retain the full 1/2/3/5 sweep trajectory for empirical RQ3 repair-transfer analysis.

retry_ceilings.basis: Policy cap set in pilot_config.json#retry_and_timeout_policy before any request is made, per ROADMAP.md's requirement that transport retries be capped by design -- this is a ceiling (a maximum allowed), not a measurement of an observed retry rate, which does not exist yet (pilot_estimate.json#not_estimated_at_all).
retry_ceilings.semantic_attempt_vs_transport_retry: A malformed/invalid/refused model response always consumes one of the repair_proposal_sweep's counted proposals; it is never treated as a free transport retry regardless of cause.

explicitly_not_frozen_by_this_file: Final M6 dataset-wide repository counts and splits (needs Phase 6 supply data).
Final M7/M8 numeric budgets for Arms A and B (needs an admitted development repository to run a direct-patching loop against at all).
Any ceiling for SQLAlchemy or Pydantic pilots (their evidence packets and configs were not authored this pass).
